summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: McIlroy Shares BMW Lead
items.text: Rory McIlroy shot a bogey-free 6-under 64 to share a five-way lead at Thursday's opening round of the BMW Championship, part of the FedEx Cup playoffs.

items.headline: Scheffler Calls for LIV Penalties
items.text: Scottie Scheffler said certain LIV Golf players could add value to the PGA Tour but must face penalties before they are allowed to return.
